title: Brain RPC v1 method schemas (backend-runtime-v1)
description: Wire envelopes, auth claims, error model, and per-method request/response shapes for Brain RPC contract major 1. Portal invokes host operations over the authenticated egress-only relay WebSocket (brain_rpc_request / brain_rpc_result). Hermes-Lanyard is the v1 reference implementation. This monorepo owns the contract; backends publish artifacts that claim contract.brain_rpc: 1 and implement the required methods.
$comment: Top-level is a catalog document. Validate individual frames and method payloads against the $defs listed in x-lanyard-validation-entrypoints.

contractVersion.description: Brain RPC method-set major. Mismatch → version_unsupported.

requestId.description: Unique per attempt; echoed on the result frame.

iso8601.description: UTC timestamp, preferably ISO-8601 with milliseconds and Z (e.g. 2026-07-12T00:00:00.000Z).

vaultPath.description: Vault-root-relative POSIX path starting with /. Reject .. segments, null bytes, and host-absolute breakout. Normalized form: collapse . and //, strip trailing slash except for root /.

documentRevisionKind.description: How revision.token was produced. Production Office writeback requires etag|content_hash|host_revision (not mtime_size_fallback). Aligns with lp-5q6.17 binary transfer + revision contract.

documentRevision.description: Host-owned identity of specific bytes at a vault path. Used for ONLYOFFICE document.key material, Office session base_revision, and vault.write compare-and-swap (expected_revision / if_match). Opaque token compared with constant-time equality on the host. Never a file body.

token.description: Opaque revision token (e.g. sha256 hex with kind content_hash, strong etag, or host UUID).

size_bytes.description: Content length at this revision when known.

modified_at.description: ISO-8601 timestamp for UI only — never sole CAS key.

vaultEntry.description: Vault metadata entry (list/stat). No file bodies.

name.description: Basename; empty string allowed for vault root in vault.stat.

mime_type.description: Guessed MIME for files; null for directories.

size_bytes.description: File size in bytes; null for directories or when unavailable.

errorCode.description: Stable machine error code. Known v1 codes are listed; hosts may emit additional codes as strings but Portal maps unknown to internal/500.

errorCodeLoose.description: Error code on the wire (known enum preferred; unknown strings allowed for forward-compat).

message.description: Operator-safe text; never vault body excerpts or secrets.

details.description: Optional non-sensitive context (path, limit, method, size_bytes, max_bytes).

brainRpcSubject.description: Stamped by Portal BFF from control-plane RBAC — never trusted from the browser. Host re-checks fail-closed. Profile name: prefer backend_profile; hermes_profile remains the wire field used by Hermes-Lanyard today (migration alias).

backend_profile.description: Preferred platform field for the active backend profile name (admin, contributor, …).

hermes_profile.description: Legacy/wire alias of backend_profile used by Hermes-Lanyard and current Portal stamps. Accept during migration; new Portal APIs prefer backend_profile.

roles.description: Portal/control-plane role names for audit and complementary gates.

path_prefixes.description: Effective vault path ACL for this session. Empty + vault_full → full vault; empty without vault_full → deny vault path methods. See profiles.schema.json x-lanyard-path-acl.

requiredMethodName.description: Methods every contract.brain_rpc: 1 backend must implement.

expansionMethodName.description: First-expansion methods. Optional until a backend implements and advertises them on the artifact manifest. Not required for v1 conformance. brain.capabilities is the selected live discovery path for the backend capability descriptor (see capabilities.schema.json).

methodName.description: Dotted method name. Required set is requiredMethodName; expansion and future additive methods use the same pattern.

resultMeta.description: Optional diagnostics. Must never include vault file bodies or secrets.

hermes_profile.description: Legacy profile field still emitted by Hermes-Lanyard.

timeout_ms.description: Caller budget. Defaults: 10000 for list/stat/ping/health/projects; 15000 for vault.read/settings.snapshot. Max 30000 for v1.

params.description: Method-specific params. Unknown fields ignored for forward-compat within major. See method params $defs.

idempotency_key.description: Optional; meaningful for future writes. MVP reads may ignore.

result.description: Method-specific success payload when ok is true; null when ok is false.

error.description: Error object when ok is false; null when ok is true.

params_brain_ping.description: brain.ping params. Auth L0–L3 minimum; vault ACL may be skipped.

status.description: ok = MVP read path usable; degraded = partial (e.g. projects.db missing); unavailable = cannot serve vault reads.

profile.description: Active backend profile name for the request subject.

params_vault_list.description: vault.list params. Capability: vault_read or vault_full. Path ACL enforced.

path.description: Directory to list. Default / when omitted by host convention.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination token; null/omit for first page. Hermes-Lanyard uses a decimal offset string.

entries.description: Metadata only; children the subject cannot see must be filtered out.

next_cursor.description: Opaque token for the next page; null when no more entries.

truncated.description: True when more entries remain after this page.

params_vault_stat.description: vault.stat params. Capability: vault_read or vault_full.

result_vault_stat.description: Single entry metadata, or not_found error if missing.

params_vault_read.description: vault.read params. Capability: vault_read or vault_full. Directories → invalid_argument.

max_bytes.description: Caller cap; host enforces min(caller, host_max). Host default max 1 MiB; hard max 4 MiB for MVP. Oversized → payload_too_large (no partial dump).

encoding.description: utf-8 for text-like MIME; base64 for binary.

content.description: File body as UTF-8 text or base64. Never log at host/relay by default.

size_bytes.description: Decoded byte length of the file body.

params_settings_snapshot.description: settings.snapshot params. Authenticated admin or contributor; payload always redacted.

include.description: Optional section filter; default all listed keys.

settingsCronSchedule.description: Structured schedule for product jobs.json / settings.create|update (lp-jzl.3). Prefer kind=cron with expr + display + timezone. List snapshot may still project schedule as a human string; create/update results SHOULD return this object when known.

kind.description: Schedule kind. MVP write path uses "cron"; "once" is list/display-only for offline UX.

expr.description: 5-field cron expression (minute hour dom month dow) in the wall clock of timezone.

display.description: Human schedule string for Settings primary cell (include timezone when not product-default UTC).

timezone.description: IANA timezone id (e.g. America/New_York). Preferred durable home for TZ; do not drop on write.

run_at.description: ISO-8601 instant when kind=once (list/display only for offline MVP).

settingsCron.description: Redacted scheduled-task / cron row for Portal. Compatible with LA $BACKEND_HOME/cron/jobs.json projection. List snapshot may use schedule as a display string; create/update and detail may include structured schedule + prompt.

schedule.description: Human display string (legacy list snapshot) or structured schedule object (create/update / jobs.json).

path.description: Contract-relative store path under BACKEND_HOME (typically cron/jobs.json).

prompt.description: Agent instructions / task body for the scheduled run (jobs.json prompt).

skills.description: Optional skill ids attached to the job (lp-jzl.9.2).

result_settings_snapshot.description: Redacted settings subset for Portal. Host MUST strip secret-shaped keys (api_key, token, password, authorization, headers, env, credentials, …) before send; BFF re-asserts.

source.description: Origin tag (e.g. hermes, hermes_lanyard, lanyard_agent, backend).

hermes_home.description: Legacy display path field still emitted by Hermes-Lanyard.

params_projects_list.description: projects.list params. Capability: vault_read, vault_full, or admin.

result_projects_list.description: Missing projects.db → ok with projects: [] and source none (prefer empty list over error).

params_projects_create.description: projects.create params (expansion). Callers MUST NOT invoke until capabilities advertise projects_create / projects.create. Folders are host working-directory bindings (absolute or ~ paths on Hermes-Lanyard; vault-root-relative on pure vault hosts when documented).

folders.description: Optional working-directory folder paths. First folder is treated as primary when the host creates project_folders rows.

result_projects_create.description: Created project row. Same shape as projects.list items (id + name required).

params_projects_delete.description: projects.delete params (expansion). Soft-archive of the agent project registry row only. Default semantics: set archived=true (unlist from projects.list when include_archived is false). MUST NOT delete vault/workspace folders or rmtree host disk. Callers MUST NOT invoke until capabilities advertise projects_delete / projects.delete. Future hard-purge (if ever shipped) requires a separate capability, double-confirm UI, and is out of scope for this method's default.

result_projects_delete.description: Soft-archive confirmation. archived is always true for the default (only) semantics of projects.delete.

id.description: Archived project id (echo of params.id when host keeps the same id).

archived.description: Always true. Host soft-archived the registry row; workspace/vault files remain on disk.

params_settings_patch.description: settings.patch params (expansion). Mutates a redacted settings subset that maps onto BACKEND_HOME/config.yaml (and cron/jobs.json for cron ops). Callers MUST gate on capabilities.features.settings_patch (or brain_rpc_methods includes settings.patch) for skill/mcp/model ops and cron.set_enabled. Full job create/update (cron.create / cron.update) MUST additionally gate on features.cron or brain_rpc_methods including cron.patch / cron.create / cron.update — do not treat settings_patch alone as create capability (honest LA baseline). Model ops may also be served via models.set_active when advertised; dedicated cron ops via cron.patch. BFF validates op payloads before invoke. Never accept secret-shaped keys (api_key, token, password, headers, env, credentials).

op.description: Patch operation. Maps to Hermes/config / jobs.json surfaces used by Portal Settings. cron.create/cron.update write full scheduled-task rows (lp-jzl.3).

skill_id.description: Required for skill.set_enabled. Skill id/name/folder alias matched by host.

cron_id.description: Required for cron.set_enabled and cron.update. Optional client-provided id for cron.create (host generates when omitted).

name.description: Required for cron.create. Optional for cron.update. Scheduled task display name.

prompt.description: Required for cron.create. Optional for cron.update. Agent instructions / task body (jobs.json prompt). Alias wire key: instructions.

schedule.description: Required for cron.create. Optional for cron.update. Structured schedule (prefer) or 5-field cron expr string. Portal encodes HumanSchedule via schedule codec before write.

skills.description: Optional skill ids for cron.create / cron.update (lp-jzl.9.2).

mcp_name.description: Required for mcp.set_enabled. MCP server name key under config.mcp_servers.

enabled.description: Required for skill/cron/mcp set_enabled ops. Optional for cron.create (default true) and cron.update.

provider.description: Required for model.set_active. Inference provider id (config.model.provider).

model.description: Required for model.set_active. Model id written to config.model.default (config.schema modelSettings).

result_settings_patch.description: Result of settings.patch. Returns the updated redacted entity for the op. Must not include secret-shaped keys.

source.description: Origin tag (e.g. hermes, hermes_lanyard, brain_rpc, fixture).

vaultWriteMode.description: Write semantics. Office callback and agent replace of existing files MUST use replace_if_match with expected_revision or if_match. When a dirty human Office session owns the logical path, agents MUST use write_checkpoint (or refuse with human_edit_active) — never bare overwrite (lp-5q6.32). Blind overwrite of existing files is not a v1 mode.

vaultWriteContentRef.description: Reference to bytes already staged for this write (BFF spool, host upload session, or future chunked write commit). Prefer content_ref for production Office bodies above the inline cap; do not stuff multi-MiB base64 into a single Brain RPC frame.

kind.description: Where the host/BFF should pull staged bytes from.

id.description: Opaque session/spool id minted by BFF or host. Never a vault path or file body.

content_sha256.description: Optional lowercase hex SHA-256 of the full staged body for integrity before commit.

params_vault_write.description: vault.write params (expansion, lp-5q6.18 + write_checkpoint lp-5q6.32). Capability: vault_write or vault_full. Path ACL enforced. Prefer replace_if_match + expected_revision over blind overwrites. When a dirty human edit owns the logical document, agents use mode write_checkpoint with source_path (canonical) and path (checkpoint destination). Exactly one content plane: inline content+encoding OR content_ref. Idempotency_key makes callback retries converge. Callers MUST gate on capabilities.features.vault_write and brain_rpc_methods includes vault.write; unimplemented hosts return method_not_found.

path.description: Vault-root-relative file path to create or replace. For write_checkpoint this is the checkpoint destination (not the canonical source_path). Directories → invalid_argument.

mode.description: Write mode (write_mode). create_new fails with conflict if path exists; replace_if_match requires expected_revision or if_match; replace_if_absent creates only when missing (idempotent create helper); write_checkpoint requires source_path and writes a new checkpoint path (never overwrites dirty human canonical).

expected_revision.description: CAS precondition for replace_if_match. Host compares token with constant-time equality to current revision. On mismatch → conflict (revision_mismatch), no partial write. Preferred form for Office session base_revision.

if_match.description: Shorthand CAS token equivalent to expected_revision.token when callers only hold an etag/string. For replace_if_match, at least one of expected_revision or if_match is required. If both are set, tokens must be identical or host returns invalid_argument.

encoding.description: Required when content (inline body) is present. utf-8 for text-like MIME; base64 for binary. Inline decoded size must be ≤ host inline max (default 1 MiB, hard max 4 MiB — same plane as vault.read; larger bodies use content_ref).

content.description: Inline file body as UTF-8 text or base64. Mutually exclusive with content_ref. Never log at host/relay/BFF.

content_ref.description: Staged-bytes reference for large/Office production writeback. Mutually exclusive with content/encoding.

mime_type.description: Declared MIME type of the new bytes. Host may re-sniff; gross mismatch (e.g. .docx claimed as text/plain) → invalid_type in production Office paths.

size_bytes.description: Decoded byte length of the full body (inline or staged). Host rejects when actual length differs (invalid_argument) or exceeds limits (payload_too_large). No partial vault commit on size errors.

idempotency_key.description: Caller-supplied key so retries converge. After a successful write, retries with the same key and identical body fingerprint MUST return success with the same resulting revision without double-applying side effects. Frame-level idempotency_key may mirror this field; params value is authoritative for vault.write.

create_parents.description: When true, create missing parent directories within the path ACL. Default false → not_found if parent missing.

source_path.description: Required when mode is write_checkpoint. Canonical vault path the agent intended to update (ownership subject). Must differ from path (checkpoint destination). Both path and source_path are subject to path ACL.

result_vault_write.description: vault.write success result. New host revision after durable commit. Idempotent replay returns the same revision/written_at as the original success for that idempotency_key. Optional commit metadata (lp-ye4.8) links the write to the signed-operation ledger without breaking clients that ignore unknown/optional fields.

revision.description: New content revision after write (content_hash preferred).

etag.description: Optional etag string for HTTP-oriented callers. When present, SHOULD equal revision.token when revision.kind is etag; otherwise may echo revision.token.

size_bytes.description: Decoded byte length of the committed file body.

mime_type.description: Stored or guessed MIME after write.

created.description: True when this write created a new path; false when it replaced existing bytes.

idempotent_replay.description: True when this response is a converged replay of a prior successful write for the same idempotency_key.

source_path.description: When mode was write_checkpoint, echo of the canonical source_path.

write_kind.description: Optional write kind for pane/artifact alignment. write_checkpoint success SHOULD set checkpoint.

commit.description: Optional signed-operation ledger commit metadata (lp-ye4.8). Hosts that maintain a multiplayer ledger SHOULD include this on successful vault.write. Clients MUST tolerate absence (backward compatible). operation_id is SEPARATE from DocumentRevision.token and MUST NOT be used as a CAS token.

operation_id.description: Ledger operation_id for this commit (history/head pointer). Never equal to revision.token.

kind.description: Ledger operation kind mapped from vault.write mode (create_new→file_create, replace_if_match→file_replace, replace_if_absent→file_create|file_replace by outcome, write_checkpoint→file_checkpoint).

workspace_id.description: Workspace id whose tree head advanced when known (default workspace is typically "default").

tree_root_hash.description: workspace_head.tree_root_hash after this commit when the workspace head advanced.

advances_artifact_head.description: True when this commit advanced the artifact head for path (normal success).

advances_workspace_head.description: True when this commit advanced the workspace tree head.

params_expansion_placeholder.description: Placeholder for optional expansion methods. Exact shapes land when those methods are implemented and this contract is extended additively. Callers must not rely on expansion methods unless the artifact advertises them.

result_expansion_placeholder.description: Placeholder success shape for optional expansion methods.

params_vault_read_chunk.description: vault.read_chunk params (optional expansion, lp-5q6.17). Capability: vault_read or vault_full. Streams large files without single-shot vault.read. Directories → invalid_argument.

max_bytes.description: Caller chunk cap; host enforces min(caller, host_chunk_max). Default host chunk 256 KiB; hard max 1 MiB decoded.

expected_revision.description: When set, host returns conflict if current revision.token differs (fail closed mid-stream).

result_vault_read_chunk.description: One decoded chunk of a vault file. content is base64 of this chunk only. Never log content.

content.description: Base64 of this chunk only. Never log.

size_bytes.description: Decoded byte length of this chunk.

eof.description: True when offset+size_bytes covers the entire file.

params_history_list.description: history.list params (optional expansion, lp-ye4.7). Path-scoped signed operation history for one vault artifact. Capability: features.history_read and brain_rpc_methods includes history.list. Path ACL enforced — hosts and BFF MUST refuse paths outside the subject path_prefixes (forbidden). Does not replace vault.stat/read or DocumentRevision CAS.

path.description: Vault-root-relative file path whose signed operation history to list.

limit.description: Max events to return (default 50; host may clamp lower).

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor (typically last operation_id from a prior page). null/omit starts from the oldest matching event.

include_rejected.description: When true (default), include operation_rejected audit events. When false, only committed events.

result_history_list.description: history.list success. events are signed_operation records (signed-operation.schema.json) in append order (oldest → newest) for the requested path after ACL filtering. operation_id remains SEPARATE from DocumentRevision.token.

events.description: Signed operation events for this path (record_type=signed_operation). Shapes: contracts/backend-runtime-v1/signed-operation.schema.json#/$defs/signedOperationEvent.

operation_id.description: Ledger operation id (op_…); not a DocumentRevision token.

next_cursor.description: Pass as cursor for the next page; null when no further events.

truncated.description: True when more events exist beyond this page (next_cursor set).

params_heads_artifact.description: heads.artifact params (optional expansion, lp-ye4.7). Current-head materialization for one vault path. Capability: features.heads_read and brain_rpc_methods includes heads.artifact. Path ACL enforced. revision on the head is DocumentRevision for CAS — operation_id is the ledger pointer only.

path.description: Vault-root-relative file path whose current head to read.

result_heads_artifact.description: heads.artifact success = artifact_head record. Missing head → not_found error (not an empty object). See signed-operation.schema.json#/$defs/artifactHead.

operation_id.description: Latest committed operation_id that advanced this head.

source_path.description: Canonical path when head_kind is checkpoint.

params_heads_workspace.description: heads.workspace params (optional expansion, lp-ye4.7). Workspace tree currentness. Capability: features.heads_read and brain_rpc_methods includes heads.workspace. Does not expose file bodies; still requires authenticated subject and advertised capability.

result_heads_workspace.description: heads.workspace success = workspace_head record. Missing head → not_found. See signed-operation.schema.json#/$defs/workspaceHead.

tree_root_hash.description: sha256 hex of canonical path→revision fingerprint.

x-lanyard-transport.description: Brain RPC rides the authenticated egress-only relay WebSocket (same session trust domain as chat). No public inbound host port for RPC.
x-lanyard-transport.encoding: Newline-delimited JSON on the authenticated relay session

x-lanyard-timeouts.host_abort: On timeout return error code timeout with retryable true when safe to retry the read; vault.write timeouts must not leave partial durable commits

x-lanyard-error-http-map.description: BFF maps host error.code → HTTP status for browser APIs.

x-lanyard-expansion-methods.description: First-expansion method names planned for later contract increments. OPTIONAL until implemented and advertised on the artifact manifest capabilities.brain_rpc_methods (and/or capabilities.features). v1 conformance does NOT require these. Hosts that receive an unimplemented expansion method return method_not_found.

methods.name: brain.capabilities
methods.purpose: Live backend capability descriptor for Portal feature gating
methods.notes: Selected discovery path (not relay hello). Normative shape lives in capabilities.schema.json. Portal falls back to artifact manifest capabilities when method_not_found.

methods.name: projects.create
methods.purpose: Create a project row / working directory binding
methods.notes: Defined before Portal UI enablement (lp-k7g.8.3). UI/BFF must gate on capability advertisement. Control-plane vault_path projects remain a separate surface from agent working-directory projects.

methods.name: projects.delete
methods.purpose: Soft-archive an agent project registry row (unlist from Directory); never purge workspace disk by default
methods.notes: lp-uxy.5: normative wire is {id} → {id, archived:true}. Soft-archive only — does not rmtree vault/workspace folders. Portal confirm copy must state files stay on disk. Hard purge is not part of this method default.

methods.name: settings.patch
methods.purpose: Mutate a redacted settings subset (skills/MCP enable, cron enable/create/update, active model)
methods.capability_hint: features.settings_patch or brain_rpc_methods includes settings.patch; cron.create/cron.update also require features.cron or cron.patch/cron.create/cron.update methods
methods.notes: Defined before Portal settings editor enablement (lp-k7g.8.4). BFF validates against config.schema.json surfaces. UI/BFF must gate on capability advertisement; unavailable methods return method_not_found with clear unavailable state. Full scheduled-task create/update (lp-jzl.3) uses settings.patch cron.create/cron.update writing $BACKEND_HOME/cron/jobs.json — gate create independently of mere set_enabled.

methods.name: vault.write
methods.purpose: Write or create a single vault file with CAS expected-revision and idempotent retries
methods.capability_hint: vault_write or vault_full; path ACL enforced; features.vault_write + brain_rpc_methods includes vault.write for vault_editor UI
methods.notes: Typed expansion (lp-5q6.18). Prefer replace_if_match + expected_revision/if_match. Inline content capped like vault.read; production Office writeback uses content_ref (staged/chunked). Advertise vault.write only when implemented — vault_editor must stay unsupported otherwise.

methods.name: vault.read_chunk
methods.purpose: Read a bounded byte range of a vault file for BFF streaming (Office binary plane)
methods.capability_hint: vault_read or vault_full; path ACL enforced
methods.notes: Portable large-file transfer over egress-only Brain RPC (lp-5q6.17). Not a substitute for vault.read small-file preview. Document Server never calls this; BFF only.

methods.name: history.list
methods.purpose: List signed operation history for one vault artifact path (multiplayer audit/currentness)
methods.capability_hint: features.history_read and brain_rpc_methods includes history.list; path ACL enforced
methods.notes: lp-ye4.7 phase 3. Returns signed_operation events (not DocumentRevision CAS tokens). BFF stamps BackendRuntimeContext and enforces path ACL before returning history. Advertise only when implemented — otherwise method_not_found.

methods.name: heads.artifact
methods.purpose: Read current artifact head (operation_id + DocumentRevision) for one vault path
methods.capability_hint: features.heads_read and brain_rpc_methods includes heads.artifact; path ACL enforced
methods.notes: lp-ye4.7. Materialized currentness for multiplayer; separate from vault.stat which may omit operation_id. Advertise only when implemented.

methods.name: heads.workspace
methods.purpose: Read current workspace tree head (tree_root_hash + operation_id)
methods.notes: lp-ye4.7. Workspace currentness fingerprint for multiplayer sync. Advertise only when implemented.

methods.name: cron.patch
methods.purpose: Create/update/pause cron jobs (dedicated RPC; Portal MVP also uses settings.patch ops cron.create/cron.update/cron.set_enabled when advertised)
methods.notes: lp-jzl.3: Portal offline create path uses settings.patch cron.create/cron.update with honest features.cron / cron.* method gates. Dedicated cron.patch remains the aspirational expansion method name for hosts that implement it separately.

brain.ping.purpose: Liveness / echo through the RPC path
brain.ping.auth: L0–L3 minimum; host may skip vault ACL

settings.snapshot.redaction: Strip secret-shaped keys before send; never put provider API keys on the wire

projects.list.purpose: List backend projects for Portal pickers

x-lanyard-vault-write.description: Normative vault.write expansion policy (lp-5q6.18). write_checkpoint + human_edit_active agent policy: lp-5q6.32. CAS semantics align with lp-5q6.17 binary transfer + revision contract.

capability.advertise_rule: features.vault_write true AND brain_rpc_methods includes vault.write only when the host implements typed vault.write; otherwise vault_editor must be unsupported

modes.replace_if_match: CAS with expected_revision or if_match; conflict on revision_mismatch; no partial write
modes.replace_if_absent: Create only when missing (idempotent create helper)
modes.write_checkpoint: Write a staged checkpoint path; requires source_path (canonical). Used when dirty human Office ownership blocks overwrite of the logical path (lp-5q6.32).

inline.note: Same plane as vault.read; not production Office save for large bodies

idempotency.behavior: Same key + same body fingerprint after success converges to success with same resulting revision; no double side effects

forbidden.when: Path ACL deny or profile lacks vault_write/vault_full

conflict.when: revision_mismatch (replace_if_match), create_new path exists, replace_if_absent path exists with different body intent, or agent targets a path with dirty human Office ownership (details.reason=human_edit_active)

human_edit_active.when: Dirty Office edit session owns the path; agent must write_checkpoint or refuse (lp-5q6.32)

payload_too_large.when: Decoded size exceeds inline or Office aggregate max; no partial commit

invalid_type.when: MIME/extension/sniff family mismatch on production Office write path

invalid_argument.when: Directory target, bad mode preconditions, content and content_ref both/neither set, size_bytes mismatch, token mismatch between if_match and expected_revision

method_not_found.when: Host does not implement vault.write (must not advertise method or vault_editor)

not_found.when: replace_if_match on missing path, or missing parent without create_parents

timeout.when: Host exceeded timeout without durable commit

internal.when: Unexpected host fault; retry only when host marks retryable true

agent_human_edit_policy.notes: BFF findActiveOwnership is authoritative for dirty Office sessions; host CAS remains defense in depth.

preferred.backend_profile: Auth subject / meta field for the active profile
preferred.backend_artifact: Health versions field for the backend release

legacy_wire_aliases.hermes_profile: Still stamped/checked by Hermes-Lanyard; alias of backend_profile
legacy_wire_aliases.hermes_home: Settings snapshot field; alias of backend_home
legacy_wire_aliases.hermes_home_present: Health check key; alias of backend_home_present
legacy_wire_aliases.hermes_artifact: Health versions key; alias of backend_artifact
legacy_wire_aliases.hermes_projects_db: projects.list source tag for Hermes-compatible DBs

x-lanyard-baselines.deploy_contract: company-brain-deploy/references/brain-rpc-contract.md (historical G3.1 authority; platform monorepo now owns machine-readable schemas)

x-lanyard-office-binary-transfer.description: Normative Office binary transfer and revision policy (lp-5q6.17). Full prose: docs/architecture/portal-binary-vault-transfer-and-revision.md
x-lanyard-office-binary-transfer.lab_fixture_exception: deployment_tier lab|test and file ≤ vault.read hard max may use preview JSON for mechanical proof only
